instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "See how much of a packing list or other checklist is done and group its items, for example by category", and give it items (The checklist's items: id, status, group); done_statuses (Statuses that mean the item is done); skipped_statuses (Statuses whose items are left out of the count (still listed in their group)).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:measure-a-checklist and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give the items (id, status, and optionally group) and which statuses mean done and which statuses leave the count (an item no longer needed).
